verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no iTerm2 statement or control about whether user data may be used to train AI models: no training opt-out, no data-use policy, no provider retention guarantee. The documented separate AI plugin, which ensures nothing is accidentally sent over the network, is an adjacent network-isolation control rather than a training-use protection. Routing the AI URL to a local Ollama endpoint is a community workaround, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
